{{Quote|Energy flows through everything in the galaxy, creating life. Healing it. As long as the galaxy exists, life will find a way.|[[Cade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy—War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>}}
The legendary [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] [[Beam of light|sacrificed herself]] to create an opening in the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith-Imperial]] fleet for her allies to escape the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on the planet [[Taivas]] during the [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] there in [[138 ABY]]. Some time after her death, numerous '''tiny saplings''' burst out of the ground, ensuring that her legacy as a Jedi Master would live on forever.<ref name="Legacy—War 6" />
